title: Evaluating Agents
learning_objectives: Define pass/fail criteria for an agent task: answer, budget and forbidden actions
Run a suite of tasks, isolating crashes so one failure does not stop the run
Compare two agent versions and list regressions
hints: Wrap only the agent call in `try/except Exception as e:` and record `f"error: {type(e).__name__}"`.
For regressions build `{r["id"]: r["passed"] for r in report["results"]}` for both reports.

failure_feedback.advice: Lowercase, collapse whitespace, then strip trailing '.' and '!'.
Check status, answer, budget and forbidden tools in that order; an exception gives only an error reason.
Average tool calls only over tasks that returned a result.
Call the agent exactly once per task, in order.
A regression passed before and fails (or is missing) now; return ids sorted.
